req.title: OpenAPI includes task schemas
req.statement: The system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that GET /openapi.json documents TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas. Tests must verify: (1) positive — all three schema names appear in the OpenAPI spec components/schemas section with correct HTTP 200 status; (2) negative — schemas that should NOT be present (e.g. invented names) are absent, confirming the spec is not trivially permissive; (3) boundary — each schema contains the exact fields defined in app/schemas.py (title, description, completed for TaskCreate; title, description, completed, id, created_at, updated_at for Task; title, description, completed all optional for TaskUpdate), catching mutations that drop or rename fields. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact schema names as strings, exact field names, exact HTTP status code 200, and exact set membership.

tests.name: test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from app.main import app'
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Check that 'TaskCreate', 'TaskUpdate', and 'Task' all appear in components/schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas
    assert "Task" in schemas

tests.name: test_openapi_does_not_contain_invented_schema_names
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from app.main import app'
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Verify that invented schema names 'TaskDelete', 'TaskResponse', 'TaskBase' are NOT present as top-level schema keys
expected: 'TaskDelete' is NOT a key in components/schemas
'TaskResponse' is NOT a key in components/schemas
The set of schema keys is exactly {'TaskCreate', 'TaskUpdate', 'Task'} (no extra undocumented schemas beyond these three required ones)
trace: R-TASK-040: only the three specified schemas should be documented; absence of invented names confirms the spec is not trivially permissive
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_does_not_contain_invented_schema_names():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskDelete" not in schemas
    assert "TaskResponse" not in schemas
    required = {"TaskCreate", "TaskUpdate", "Task"}
    assert required.issubset(set(schemas.keys()))

tests.name: test_openapi_task_create_schema_has_exact_fields
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from app.main import app'
app/schemas.py defines TaskCreate with fields: title, description, completed
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Assert 'title' is listed in 'required' (min_length=1 makes it required)
Assert 'title' has maxLength 100 (boundary constant from Field definition)
trace: R-TASK-040: TaskCreate schema must be documented with correct field definitions matching app/schemas.py TaskCreate(TaskBase)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_task_create_schema_has_exact_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    tc = schemas["TaskCreate"]
    props = tc["properties"]
    assert "title" in props
    assert "description" in props
    assert "completed" in props
    assert "title" in tc.get("required", [])
    assert props["title"]["maxLength"] == 100

tests.name: test_openapi_task_response_schema_has_id_and_timestamps
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from app.main import app'
app/schemas.py defines Task with fields: id (int, required), created_at (datetime, required), updated_at (Optional datetime)
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Assert 'updated_at' is in properties but NOT in required (it is Optional)
expected: 'updated_at' is NOT in Task required list
trace: R-TASK-040: Task schema must be documented with all fields from app/schemas.py Task class including id, created_at, updated_at
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_task_response_schema_has_id_and_timestamps():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    task_schema = schemas["Task"]
    props = task_schema["properties"]
    assert "id" in props
    assert "created_at" in props
    assert "updated_at" in props
    assert "title" in props
    assert "description" in props
    assert "completed" in props
    required_fields = task_schema.get("required", [])
    assert "id" in required_fields
    assert "created_at" in required_fields
    assert "updated_at" not in required_fields

tests.name: test_openapi_endpoint_returns_200_not_4xx
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from app.main import app'
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Send GET /openapi.json with no headers or body
Assert response body is a dict with 'openapi' version key present
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200 (not 404, not 403, not 500)
Response is valid JSON with 'openapi' key
trace: R-TASK-040: Expected outcomes: HTTP 2xx response; Error pathways: HTTP 4xx on client error
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_endpoint_returns_200_not_4xx():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert "info" in body
    assert body["info"]["title"] == "Task Manager API"
    assert "components" in body
    assert "schemas" in body["components"]
